name: GitHub
summary: Use York GitHub Enterprise repositories and development tools

details.title: Enterprise GitHub
details.html: York GitHub Enterprise gives faculty and staff version control, collaboration, pull requests, project management, issues and organizational administration. Access is included for eligible employees; organization membership determines which repositories you can use

details.title: GitHub organizations
details.html: Organization owners manage members, GitHub Actions availability, policies and GitHub Copilot assignments. Existing organization members should ask an owner for access; managers can request a new organization through the York process

details.title: Copilot and paid features
details.html: GitHub Copilot is a separate paid AI coding capability. Enabling it requires organizational setup and individual licence assignment. The published service page describes a departmental Azure subscription and per-user billing; verify rates and approvals before purchasing
